## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (format, lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage)
- [ ] `bun run test:browser` passes, if the change touches components, keys or styles
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] The changelog has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`, if users will notice the change
- [ ] Docs and the README are updated, if the API changed
